business.default_definition: Configured ERP document; validate the field labels and owning process with the implementation data steward before import.

domains.Finance: Accounting and settlement records managed by the finance process owner.
domains.HR: Employee and workforce records managed by the HR process owner.
domains.Inventory: Stock, storage and movement records managed by the inventory process owner.
domains.Procurement: Supplier purchasing records managed by the procurement process owner.
domains.Sales: Customer demand and selling records managed by the sales process owner.

definitions.Customer: Party receiving goods or services; access and consent must follow the approved customer process.
definitions.Item: Product master identifying a sellable, purchasable or stocked SKU; operational settings control tracking and validation.
definitions.Vendor: Party supplying goods or services; procurement maintains identity and commercial references.

business.key_policy: Physical primary and unique keys are listed in registry.keys. JSON business identifiers and numbering rules are additional application controls; do not infer global uniqueness from a field label.
business.tenant_scope: The captured schema is tenant_default in development. Tenant, entity, location and owner authorization must be checked by the service; copying a document identifier does not grant access.
business.retention: No universal duration is approved. Apply the signed jurisdiction, document-class and customer retention schedule and legal holds before purge; preserve required audit and transactional records.
business.classification: The sensitive-field registry identifies known protected fields. Every other field needs process-owner classification before export; absence from that registry is not a public-data designation.

reports.label: Profit & Loss
reports.question: Did we make money in this period?
reports.description: Revenue less expenses by account for the dates chosen; each line drills to its GL postings.

reports.label: Balance Sheet
reports.question: What do we own and owe on a date?
reports.description: Assets, liabilities and equity as at the date chosen; each line drills to its GL postings.

reports.label: Cash Flow Statement
reports.question: Where did the cash come from and go?
reports.description: Cash in and out on 1100 for the dates chosen, by activity.

reports.label: GL Drill-down (by Account)

reports.description: Every posting on one account, oldest first, with a running balance.

reports.label: Customer Ledger
reports.question: What has this customer been invoiced?
reports.description: Customer invoices with status and amount.

reports.label: Tax Ledger
reports.question: What GST did we post, line by line?
reports.description: Every posting on the GST accounts, optionally for a date range.

reports.label: Statutory Audit Export (Full GL)
reports.question: What does the auditor need from the ledger?
reports.description: The full GL for a closed period, with poster, for export.

reports.label: General Journal (who posted what)
reports.question: Who posted what, and from which document?
reports.description: Every GL line in the period with the user, job or integration that posted it.

reports.label: GRN Register - every line, every step

reports.description: Every GRN line with the PO, invoice and verified figures, MRP and who did each step.

reports.label: Invoice vs GRN Differences
reports.question: Where do vendor invoices differ from what we received?
reports.description: Invoiced against received-and-verified, by vendor and month, with the notes raised.

reports.label: Purchase Price Changes
reports.question: Which purchase prices changed?
reports.description: Items received at a price different from the last purchase, with the old and new MRP.

reports.label: Goods Receipts Waiting
reports.question: Which goods receipts are waiting, and for what?
reports.description: Receipts not yet verified, priced or posted, oldest first.

reports.label: GRN Corrections Log
reports.question: What was changed on a goods receipt?
reports.description: Every change at every step: was, now, who, when and why.

reports.label: PO vs GRN Price Variance
reports.question: Are we paying what the PO agreed?
reports.description: Received price against the PO price per line.

reports.label: GRN Payments
reports.question: What do we still owe on goods received?
reports.description: Each posted receipt with what we owe, what is paid and what is due.

reports.label: Goods In Receiving
reports.question: What has arrived but is not in stock yet?
reports.description: Goods on receipts still being verified, priced or posted - not sellable until their child GRN posts.

reports.label: Non-Valuated Stock
reports.question: Which stock has no cost on record?
reports.description: Items with stock but no unit cost - valued at zero until costed.

reports.label: Order Aging
reports.question: Which orders are waiting too long?
reports.description: Open orders by age and status.

reports.label: SLA Breach
reports.question: Which orders missed their promise?

reports.label: Return Aging
reports.question: Which returns are waiting to be processed?

reports.label: Payroll Reconciliation (gross to bank to GL)

reports.label: Reorder Suggestions (Configured)
